notes.title: Version 1.09
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added an [b]easy difficulty mode[/b] and a hi-score table for this mode.
[*] Added [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b], [b]German[/b] and [b]Russian[/b] translations.
[*] Added volume option to the menu.
[*] Removed the ‘Stargate’ symbols from portals by default. They can be reactivated by writing ‘stargate’ at the main menu.
[*] For advanced users, added 2 command line options:
[list]
[*] --filter 0 : disables the linear graphics filtering.
[*] --scale n : where n is a pixel scale. For example, --scale 1 sets the original pixel size, so the game will run on a window of size 256x224; --scale 2 sets a double pixel size, so the game will run on a window of 5122x448; etc. You can always use Alt + Enter to switch to fullscreen.
[/list]
[*] The game is also released at [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.jorgicor.planetvcd]Google Play Store[/url] for Android!
[/list]
